name: app-publisher
description: Local Codex workflows and MCP for Apple and Google app publishing

interface.shortDescription: Set up, prepare and publish mobile apps.
interface.longDescription: Guided first-app setup with automatic Codex in-app browser or manual instructions, Apple provisioning, metadata, signed builds and releases. Credentials stay on your computer. Requires Node.js and store API access; automatic card creation requires host browser tools.
defaultPrompt: Help me create a new store app.
Check the release status of my app.
Prepare a signed build for internal testing.
